candidates.change_summary: Replace `msg.sender` with a constant address in the `new EmergencyOracle(...)` creation so the new oracle owner differs.
Delete the `emit NewEmergencyOracle(...)` statement so the event is never emitted, changing the externally observable event log after the call.
Replace `msg.sender` with `tx.origin` in the `NewEmergencyOracle` event emission so the logged owner address differs for some callers.
Replace `msg.sender` with `address(this)` in the `new EmergencyOracle(...)` constructor call so the oracle owner becomes the factory contract, not the caller.
Delete the body of the `onlyJojoTeam` modifier so anyone can call `newEmergencyOracle`, changing who can create oracles.
